usage.callShape: POST https://api.agentphone.ai/x402/v1/numbers with JSON body {country?, areaCode?, agentId?} (all optional; e.g. {"country":"US"}) to provision a real, active phone number ($0.01)
usage.outputShape: body.id (the number_id used later as number_id/fromNumberId), body.phoneNumber (E.164), body.status ("active"), body.type ("sms"), body.country, body.agentId, body.createdAt
quirks: DELIVERY HUMAN-CONFIRMED 2026-06-09: the user (John, +15555550123) actually received the output — an inbound phone call from +15076072903 and two "MasterKey QA test SMS" texts — confirming end-to-end real-world delivery, not just a paid 200.
Body fields are ALL optional — {"country":"US"} works; an empty {} likely also works. No agent_id needed to provision a number (returned agentId was null).
Returns 200 synchronously with a real, ACTIVE phone number immediately — no async/polling. The number is a live billable resource (outward/irreversible).
Save body.id — it is the number_id (a.k.a. fromNumberId) you must pass to POST /x402/v1/messages and /x402/v1/calls for dedicated caller ID.
Returned type was 'sms' (not iMessage). send_style iMessage animations on /messages only work on iMessage-capable numbers.
Real backend in the 402 header is api.paysponge.com (transparent proxy); api.agentphone.ai/x402/v1 is the gateway entry point.
Paid on Base, x402 'exact' scheme, $0.01. (Note: /calls endpoints instead use 'upto' permit2 up to $0.50 — different flow, not this endpoint.)
usage.guide: Provision a real phone number for an AI agent by POSTing to https://api.agentphone.ai/x402/v1/numbers with a small JSON body like {"country":"US"} (areaCode and agentId are optional). It pays $0.01 USDC on Base via x402 and returns 200 synchronously with the new number. Read body.phoneNumber for the E.164 number and body.id for the number_id you'll pass as number_id/fromNumberId to the /messages and /calls endpoints. The number comes back status:"active" immediately — no polling. This creates a live billable resource, so only provision when actually needed.
